column1: #mapping_set_description: "Mappings from the terms of Foxxi Content Intelligence vocabulary (https://foxxi-bridge.interego.xwisee.com/ns/foxxi) to other vocabularies: one row for each SKOS mapping the ontology makes, generated from it."

#comment: "An original vocabulary of the Foxxi vertical, by Mark Spivey (Foxxi Mediums Inc.). It formalizes no standard; its xAPI concepts are typed with classes of ADL's xAPI ontology (https://w3id.org/xapi/ontology), which is not affiliated with or endorsing this vocabulary."
